vocabulary.meaning: The -ing form of a verb used as a noun

meaning_translation.Hindi: क्रिया का -ing रूप जो संज्ञा के रूप में प्रयोग होता है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 動詞の -ing 形を名詞として使う

translation.Japanese: 私は本を読むのが好きです。

vocabulary.meaning: The base form of a verb with 'to', often showing purpose or intention

meaning_translation.Hindi: क्रिया का मूल रूप 'to' के साथ, अक्सर उद्देश्य या इरादे को दर्शाने के लिए
meaning_translation.Japanese: to + 動詞の原形で、目的や意図を示すことが多い

translation.Hindi: वह विदेश में पढ़ाई करना चाहती है।

vocabulary.meaning: Verbs like enjoy, like, love, hate, prefer, which are followed by gerunds or infinitives

meaning_translation.Hindi: क्रियाएँ जैसे enjoy, like, love, hate, prefer जो gerund या infinitive के साथ आती हैं
meaning_translation.Japanese: enjoy, like, love, hate, prefer など、動名詞や不定詞を伴う動詞

examples.sentence: I prefer staying at home to going out.

translation.Hindi: मैं बाहर जाने की बजाय घर पर रहना पसंद करता हूँ।
translation.Japanese: 外出するより家にいる方が好きです。

vocabulary.meaning: Showing why something is done, often expressed with an infinitive

meaning_translation.Hindi: यह दिखाना कि कुछ क्यों किया जाता है, अक्सर infinitive से व्यक्त किया जाता है
meaning_translation.Japanese: なぜ何かをするのかを示す、不定詞で表すことが多い

examples.sentence: She studies hard to pass the exam.

translation.Hindi: वह परीक्षा पास करने के लिए कड़ी मेहनत करती है।
translation.Japanese: 彼女は試験に合格するために一生懸命勉強する。

vocabulary.meaning: A verb of preference, always followed by a gerund

meaning_translation.Hindi: एक पसंद की क्रिया, जो हमेशा gerund के साथ आती है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 好みを表す動詞で、常に動名詞を伴う

translation.Japanese: 彼はサッカーをするのを楽しんでいる。

vocabulary.meaning: A verb of desire, always followed by an infinitive

meaning_translation.Hindi: इच्छा दिखाने वाली क्रिया, हमेशा infinitive के साथ आती है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 欲望を示す動詞で、常に不定詞を伴う

examples.sentence: I want to eat pizza tonight.

translation.Hindi: मैं आज रात पिज़्ज़ा खाना चाहता हूँ।
translation.Japanese: 私は今夜ピザを食べたい。

vocabulary.meaning: Verb that changes meaning with gerund or infinitive

meaning_translation.Hindi: क्रिया जिसका अर्थ gerund या infinitive के साथ बदलता है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 動名詞と不定詞で意味が変わる動詞

examples.sentence: He stopped smoking. (quit) / He stopped to smoke. (took a break to smoke)

translation.Hindi: उसने धूम्रपान करना बंद कर दिया। / वह धूम्रपान करने के लिए रुका।
translation.Japanese: 彼は喫煙をやめた。/ 彼はタバコを吸うために立ち止まった。

vocabulary.meaning: Verb that changes meaning depending on gerund or infinitive

meaning_translation.Hindi: क्रिया जिसका अर्थ gerund या infinitive के साथ अलग होता है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 動名詞と不定詞で意味が変わる動詞

examples.sentence: Try doing yoga. (experiment) / Try to do yoga. (make an effort)

translation.Hindi: योग करने की कोशिश करो। / योग करने का प्रयास करो।
translation.Japanese: ヨガを試してみて。/ ヨガをしようと努力してみて。

vocabulary.meaning: Verb of preference, can use both gerund and infinitive

meaning_translation.Hindi: पसंद की क्रिया, gerund और infinitive दोनों का उपयोग कर सकती है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 好みを示す動詞で、動名詞と不定詞の両方が使える

examples.sentence: I prefer to walk. / I prefer walking.

translation.Japanese: 私は歩く方が好きです。

grammar_tips.title: Gerunds after Preference Verbs
grammar_tips.explanation: Verbs like enjoy, love, like, dislike, hate are usually followed by a gerund.

explanation_translation.Hindi: क्रियाएँ जैसे enjoy, love, like, dislike, hate सामान्यतः gerund के साथ आती हैं।
explanation_translation.Japanese: enjoy, love, like, dislike, hate などの動詞は通常動名詞を伴う。

grammar_tips.title: Infinitives for Purpose
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'to + verb' to show purpose. Example: She works to earn money.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'to + verb' का प्रयोग उद्देश्य दिखाने के लिए करें। उदाहरण: She works to earn money.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 'to + 動詞' を目的を示すのに使う。例：She works to earn money.

grammar_tips.title: Verb Meaning Changes
grammar_tips.explanation: Some verbs change meaning with gerund vs. infinitive (stop, try, remember, forget).

explanation_translation.Hindi: कुछ क्रियाओं का अर्थ gerund और infinitive के साथ बदल जाता है (stop, try, remember, forget)।
explanation_translation.Japanese: いくつかの動詞は動名詞と不定詞で意味が変わる（stop, try, remember, forget）。

grammar_tips.title: Gerund vs. Infinitive after Prefer
grammar_tips.explanation: Both forms are possible: I prefer to walk / I prefer walking. Gerund is more common in everyday use.

explanation_translation.Hindi: दोनों रूप संभव हैं: I prefer to walk / I prefer walking। रोज़मर्रा के प्रयोग में gerund अधिक सामान्य है।
explanation_translation.Japanese: どちらの形も可能：I prefer to walk / I prefer walking。日常では動名詞がよく使われる。

grammar_tips.title: Infinitives after Certain Verbs
grammar_tips.explanation: Want, need, decide, plan, hope, learn, agree are always followed by infinitives.

explanation_translation.Hindi: Want, need, decide, plan, hope, learn, agree जैसी क्रियाएँ हमेशा infinitive के साथ आती हैं।
explanation_translation.Japanese: Want, need, decide, plan, hope, learn, agree などの動詞は常に不定詞を伴う。

vocabulary.question: Which sentence uses a gerund correctly?

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सा वाक्य सही तरीके से gerund का उपयोग करता है?
question_translation.Japanese: どの文が正しく動名詞を使っていますか？

options: She enjoys to swim in the morning.
She enjoys swimming in the morning.
She enjoy swim in the morning.

question_translation.Hindi: उसने अगले साल विदेश ___ का निर्णय लिया।
question_translation.Japanese: 彼は来年海外___と決めた。

vocabulary.question: Infinitives are often used to express purpose.

question_translation.Hindi: Infinitives का प्रयोग अक्सर उद्देश्य व्यक्त करने के लिए किया जाता है।
question_translation.Japanese: 不定詞はしばしば目的を表すのに使われる。

vocabulary.question: Which verb is usually followed by a gerund?

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सी क्रिया के बाद सामान्यतः gerund आता है?
question_translation.Japanese: どの動詞の後には通常動名詞が続きますか？

vocabulary.question: She stopped ___ because it was unhealthy.

question_translation.Hindi: उसने ___ बंद कर दिया क्योंकि यह अस्वस्थ था।
question_translation.Japanese: 彼女は不健康だったので___をやめた。

question_translation.Hindi: व्यवस्थित करें: [pizza, wants, eat, she, to]
question_translation.Japanese: 並べ替え: [pizza, wants, eat, she, to]

sentence.question: I prefer ___ at home to going out.

question_translation.Hindi: मैं बाहर जाने की बजाय घर पर ___ पसंद करता हूँ।
question_translation.Japanese: 外出するより家で___のが好きです。

sentence.question: Which is correct?

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सा वाक्य सही है?
question_translation.Japanese: どの文が正しいですか？

options: She hopes to pass the test.

sentence.question: They tried ___ the door, but it was stuck.

question_translation.Hindi: उन्होंने दरवाजा ___ की कोशिश की, लेकिन वह अटका हुआ था।
question_translation.Japanese: 彼らはドアを___としたが、詰まっていた。

question_translation.Hindi: व्यवस्थित करें: [reading, I, enjoy, books]
question_translation.Japanese: 並べ替え: [reading, I, enjoy, books]

listening.question: What does the speaker prefer?
listening.audio_text: I prefer walking to taking the bus.

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता को क्या अधिक पसंद है?
question_translation.Japanese: 話者は何を好みますか？

listening.question: The sentence 'She wants to learn Spanish.' uses an infinitive.

question_translation.Hindi: वाक्य 'She wants to learn Spanish.' infinitive का उपयोग करता है।
question_translation.Japanese: 文 'She wants to learn Spanish.' は不定詞を使っている。

listening.question: What is the purpose expressed here?
listening.audio_text: He studies hard to pass the exam.

question_translation.Hindi: यहाँ कौन सा उद्देश्य व्यक्त किया गया है?
question_translation.Japanese: ここで表現されている目的は何ですか？

listening.question: Which word shows preference?
listening.audio_text: I enjoy listening to music in the evening.

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सा शब्द पसंद दर्शाता है?
question_translation.Japanese: どの単語が好みを示していますか？

listening.question: The sentence 'He stopped to talk to his friend.' means he quit talking.
listening.audio_text: He stopped to talk to his friend.

question_translation.Hindi: वाक्य 'He stopped to talk to his friend.' का अर्थ है कि उसने बात करना छोड़ दिया।
question_translation.Japanese: 文 'He stopped to talk to his friend.' は彼が話すのをやめたという意味です。

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'I enjoy reading books.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'I enjoy reading books.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'She wants to travel abroad.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'She wants to travel abroad.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'I prefer staying at home.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'I prefer staying at home.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'He stopped smoking last year.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'He stopped smoking last year.'

speaking.question: Say: 'She studies hard to pass exams.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'She studies hard to pass exams.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'She studies hard to pass exams.'

speaking.answer: she studies hard to pass exams
